purpose: Record the published closing number for the two markets we originate, per game, with both clubs' pages as independent confirmations. This is the reference price against which our own fair line is compared. It is not an executable offer.
opening_line_note: The publisher prints exactly one number per game and does not label it an open or a close. It is recorded here as the closing snapshot because it is the last published pre-kickoff number on that page. No opening number is estimated, interpolated or back-filled from line movement.

sources.title: 2026 Team Vegas Lines (closing spread and total, per club, weeks 1-9)
sources.authority: Secondary aggregator; historical line data credited to Sports Odds History
sources.scope: One closing spread and one closing total per game, from that club's perspective. No opening line, moneyline or player prop is published.
sources.access: Arena fetch_page rendered content; not a direct HTTP-status attestation
